additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478962-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312534694019] Meter_BC6_AC_Input error CRM:02681001461
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0478962.
The ticket has been opened for the error flag "Meter_BC6_AC_Input - current transformers potentially defective" on charger
Y2/R2 312534694019.
The error flag is known and it is active due to a misalignment between the latest FW versions of Sicharge D and the FW of the BC6 PAC meter itself. It appears that, with the latest FW version, we take into consideration a parameter related to the neutral current which, in some PAC meters with an older FW, it is not provided. This is generating the error flag.
In conclusion, the error flag it is not real per se. If the error was real, there are no side effect at the moment on this charger.
Our R&D department is working on a solution to update the PAC meters remotely, so to clear the false error flags. I will inform the colleagues from RC-FR once this solution is deployed.
Since the error flag is not generated by a real error, and there is no issue or effect on the charger, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
